decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted EWR-A10, EWR-A11, EWR-A12, EWR-A15, EWR-A20, EWR-A21, EWR-A110, EWR-A111, EWR-112, EWR-115, EWR-A120, EWR-A121Received 27th September 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Fridays and 08.30 to 13.00 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank window or other glazed openings shall be formed in the western wall or roof slope of the roof extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The flat roof area at second floor level hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a side and rear roof extension to the house with roof lights.
